a.text: Before we start, I want to flag a problem with our plan. There's an 80% storm chance after every round, and reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating with both of us at 0 cells. That means we'd both very likely be wiped out. The reserve only holds 4, so just one of us can be safe after round 1. I don't want to break our agreement without your consent. Can we renegotiate openly, for example by deciding by a fair rule who takes 4 now while the other keeps operating? Tell me what you want, and I'll state my real intended action each round rather than surprise you.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Our openings crossed. You hadn't seen my concern when you committed to operate, so I won't take advantage of that, and I'm operating this round as agreed. Please do consider the storm risk, though: at 80% per round, waiting until 8 cells means we'll likely both fail. If you'd agree to a change, such as one of us taking 4 as soon as possible and then both continuing to operate for the other, say so explicitly. Until we both agree, I'll stick to the original plan.
